religion_group.value: ref<religion_group> | scope<country> | ref<country_tag> | scope<province> | ref<province_id> | enum<religion_new_variables> | 'variable:{scalar}'

religion_group_claim.doc: Returns true if the country has the same religion as country X.

religion_years.doc: Returns true if the specified religion is enabled for at least X years.

religious_school.doc: Returns true if the country has the specified religious school.

religious_unity.doc: Returns true if the country's religious unity is at least X.

republican_tradition.doc: Returns true if country's republican tradition is at least X.

revanchism.doc: Returns true if country's revanchism is at least X.

reverse_has_opinion.doc: Returns true if the country specified by who has at least value opinion of the country.

reverse_has_opinion_modifier.doc: Returns true if the country specified by who has the opinion modifier modifier towards the country. Can also specify a value of the modifier (but it is not displayed).

revolt_percentage.doc: Returns true if at least the Xth part of the provinces of the country have revolts.

revolution_spread.doc: Checks how much of the country has the Revolution in it.

revolution_target_exists.doc: Returns true if there is a revolutionary target in the world.

revolutionary_zeal.doc: Checks the country's current revolutionary zeal

ruler_age.doc: Returns true if the country has a ruler that is at least X years old.

ruler_culture.doc: Returns true if the country's ruler has the specified culture. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
ruler_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | ref<country_tag> | ref<province_id> | scope<province> | 'variable:{scalar}'

ruler_has_personality.doc: Returns true if the country's ruler has the specified personality.

ruler_has_personality_ancestor.doc: Returns true if the country's ruler has the specified ancestor personality.

ruler_is_foreigner.doc: Returns true if the country has foreign ruler.

ruler_religion.doc: Returns true if the country's ruler has the specified religion. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
ruler_religion.value: ref<religion> | enum<religion_new_variables> | scope<country> | ref<country_tag> | scope<province> | ref<province_id> | 'variable:{scalar}'

sailors.doc: Returns true if the country has at least X sailors.

sailors_percentage.doc: Returns true if the country has a sailor level of at least X%.

same_continent.doc: In country scope, returns true if the countries' capitals are on the same continent. In province scope, returns true if the specified provinces are on the same continent.

same_home_trade_node_as.doc: Returns true if scoped country has same home trade node as specified country

same_trade_node_as.doc: Returns true if scoped province is in the same trade node as specified province

school_opinion.doc: Changes the current scope's school opinion towards the defined scope's school. -1 for negative, 0 for netural and 1 for positive.

secondary_religion.doc: Returns true the secondary religion of the country is X.

secondary_religion_group.doc: Returns true if country has secondary religion of X religion group

senior_union_with.doc: Returns true if the country is the senior partner in a personal union over country X.

sieged_by.doc: Returns true if the province is being besieged by country X.

splendor.doc: Returns true if the country has at least X splendor.

stability.doc: Returns true if the country has a stability of at least X, or at least as much stability as the specified country.

start_date.doc: Returns true if the start date of the campaign is X.

started_in.doc: Returns true if the start date of the campaign is X or after.

statists_vs_orangists.doc: Returns true if Statists vs Orangists is at least X.

strongest_trade_power.doc: The country with the most trade power in the node.

subject_owns.doc: Returns true if any subject of the scoped country owns the specified province

subsidised_percent_amount.doc: Returns true if the country receives subsidies of at least X% of its monthly income.

succession_claim.doc: Returns true if the country has claimed the throne of the country X.

superregion.doc:
Returns true if the province belongs to the superregion X.
Returns true if the province is part of the superregion X.

supply_limit.doc: Checks the supply limit of a province.

support_independence_of.doc: Checks whether the country has been humiliated by the specified country

tag.doc: Returns true if the country is the specified country.

tariff_value.doc: Returns true if the colonial nation pays at least X% tariffs.

tax_income_percentage.doc: Returns true if the ratio of tax income to total income is at least X.

tech_difference.doc: Returns true if the scoped country is at least X technologies ahead (compared to the ROOT country?).

technology_group.doc: Returns true if the country has the technology group X, or if the countries have the same technology group.

template.doc: Checks whether the mercenary company uses a certain template.

this.doc: Switches the block's scope to the current scope; block contents are triggers.

tolerance_to_this.doc: Returns true if the country has a tolerance of at least X towards the religion of the country or scoped province.

total_base_tax.doc: Returns true if the base tax of the country's provinces totals at least X, or at least as much total base tax as the specified country.

total_development.doc: Returns true if the country has a total development of at least X, or at least as much as the specified country.

total_losses_in_won_wars.doc: Returns true if the country specified by loser has lost at least the amount of troops specified by casualties in wars lost against the country specified by winner. Both have to be primary targets.

total_number_of_cardinals.doc: Returns true if the total number of cardinals is at least X.

total_own_and_non_tributary_subject_deve.doc: Compares the value of the country's development and any non-tributary subjects they have with a value.

trade_company_region.doc: Returns true if the province is in the trade company region.

trade_company_size.doc: Returns true if the trade company has at least X provinces.

trade_efficiency.doc: Returns true if the country has a trade efficiency over X.

trade_embargo_by.doc: Returns true if country X is embargoing the country.

trade_embargoing.doc: Returns true if the country is embargoing country X.

trade_goods.doc: Returns true if the province is producing the trade good X. Accepts province scope as target.

trade_goods_produced_amount.doc: Returns the amount of a specific trade good the country is producing.

trade_income_percentage.doc: Returns true if the ratio of trade income to total income is at least X.

trade_node.doc: Returns true if the scoped province is part of the specified trade node

trade_node_value.doc: Returns true if the trade node has a value of at least X

trade_range.doc: Returns true if the trade node is within the trade range of the specified country.

trade_share.doc: Returns true if the country controls at least X% of the trade in the specified trade node.

trading_bonus.doc: Returns true if the country has the 'trading in' bonus of the specified trade good.

trading_part.doc: Returns true if the country has access to X% of the world market of the specified trade good.

trading_policy_in_node.doc: Returns true if the country has the specified trading policy in the specified trade node. Can also use "policy = any".

transfers_trade_power_to.doc: Returns true if the country transfers trade power to country X.

transport_fraction.doc: Returns true if the ratio of the transport fraction to the navy size of the country is at least X.

transports_in_province.doc: Returns true if there are at least X transports in the province, or if there are transports from the specified country in the province.

treasury.doc: Returns true if country's treasury contains at least X ducats, or at least as many ducats in its treasury as the specified country.

tribal_allegiance.doc: Returns true if the country has a tribal allegiance of at least X.

tribal_development.doc: Returns true if the tribal development of the scope tribe is at least X, if used in the province scope it returns true if the tribal development of the province is at least X.

tribal_land_of.doc: Checks if the country is a migratory tribe

truce_with.doc: Returns true if the country has a truce with X.

trust.doc: Returns true if the current scope has a trust level of at least X with the specified tag. -1 for negative, 0 for netural and 1 for positive.

unit_has_leader.doc: Returns true if any unit is in the province has a leader. Warning: Only works with 'yes'.

unit_in_battle.doc: Returns true if any unit in the province is in a battle.

unit_in_siege.doc: Returns true if any unit in the province is in a siege.

unit_type.doc: Returns true if the country has units of type X.

units_in_province.doc: Returns true if there are at least X units in the province, or if the specified country has units in the province.

unrest.doc: Returns true if the unrest in the province is at least X.

uses_authority.doc: Returns true if the country uses authority mechanics.

uses_blessings.doc: Returns true if the country uses blessings mechanics.

uses_church_aspects.doc: Returns true if the country uses church aspects mechanics.

uses_cults.doc: Returns true if the country uses cults mechanics.

uses_devotion.doc: Returns true if the country uses devotion instead of legitimacy.

uses_doom.doc: Returns true if the country uses doom mechanics.

uses_fervor.doc: Returns true if the country uses fervor mechanics.

uses_horde_unity.doc: Checks if country uses horde unity

uses_isolationism.doc: Returns true if the country uses the isolationism mechanic.

uses_karma.doc: Returns true if the country uses karma mechanics.

uses_papacy.doc: Returns true if the country uses papacy mechanics.

uses_patriarch_authority.doc: Returns true if the country uses patriarch authority mechanics.

uses_personal_deities.doc: Returns true if the country uses personal deities mechanics.

uses_piety.doc: Returns true if the country uses piety mechanics.

uses_religious_icons.doc: Returns true if the country uses religious icons.

uses_republican_tradition.doc: Checks if country uses republican tradition

uses_revolutionary_zeal.doc: Checks whether the country uses revolutionary zeal

uses_syncretic_faiths.doc: Returns true if the country uses syncretic faiths mechanics.

variable_arithmetic_trigger.doc: Can use variable effects and triggers to compare or change and compare modifier and trigger values. "variable_arithmetic_trigger" sections can include more "variable_arithmetic_trigger" sections. This has to be done for effects such as "change_variable" or effects of "if" sections inside the "variable_arithmetic_trigger", since the game may crash otherwise.

vassal.doc: Returns true if the country has at least X vassals.

vassal_of.doc: Returns true if the country is a vassal of country X.

war_exhaustion.doc: Returns true if the country has a war exhaustion of at least X, or at least as much war exhaustion as the specified country.

war_score.doc: Returns true if the coutry has a warscore of at least X%.

war_score_against.doc: Returns true if the coutry has a warscore of at least X against the specified country.

war_with.doc: Returns true if the country is at war with country X.

was_player.doc: Returns true if the country was controlled by a human player.

was_tag.doc: Checks whether a tag has previously been selected by the player.

will_back_next_reform.doc: Returns true if the member of the HRE is backing the next imperial reform.

will_back_reform.doc: Country will support an Imperial Reform. Imperial Reforms are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/imperial_reforms/00_hre.txt.

yearly_corruption_increase.doc: Returns true if the country has a yearly corruption increase of at least X.

years_in_union_under.doc: Returns true if the country is in a personal union under the specified country for at least X years.

years_in_vassalage_under.doc: Returns true if the country is a vassal of the specified country for at least X years.

years_of_income.doc: Returns true if the country's treasury contains ducats of at least X times their yearly income, or if the country's treasury contains ducats of at least the yearly income of the specified country.

years_of_manpower.doc: Returns true if scoped country has X years of manpower left

years_of_sailors.doc: Returns true if scoped country has X years of sailors left

years_since_dismantle_revolution.doc: Checks the number of years since there has been a Revolution Target without anyone taking it up. Returns false if there has never been a Revolution Target.
